Two rotations and a `gcal.csv` with two presets. `primary` (weekly, midnight boundaries, `cal=team personal`) had a run on 2026-09-28 that stored the snapshot at 09-28; on 2026-10-05 the snapshot moves to 10-05, the 10-05 shift is regenerated for dave@example.com (lowest score), the pinned 10-12 shift with nobody stays a wanted gap and alice takes 10-19. `secondary` has no `cal`. The golden run (`golden.test.js`) loads the GCal extension because the directory holds a `gcal.csv`, writes the ledgers and, with no calendar in Node, shows the plan's counts in a `Calendar (no calendar)` block of `expected/status.txt` (three shifts to export, one nobody shift skipped, per preset). `gcal.test.js` compares the export plan with `expected/gcal.json`: the window runs from the stored snapshot 09-28 (the earliest instant the run may have changed) to the horizon end 10-26, so the two pinned history shifts stay out, the nobody shift is skipped (counted under `skipped`), and each of the three remaining shifts gets one event per preset: `team` all-day (auto, both instants at midnight), pale blue, free, no guests, two reminders; `personal` timed (`allday=false`), busy, with a strftime title, the note as body and dave@example.com invited because the id contains `@`. With `repair` the window starts at the first shift 09-14.
